findings.statement: The live patch covering the current meta as of 2026-08-15 is patch 7.41e (the 7.41 series). Patch 7.41 initial release date: March 24, 2026; 7.41e (current subpatch) release/announcement: July 30, 2026. Valve published multiple 7.41 subpatches between those dates (7.41a–7.41d) before 7.41e.

Razor-specific gameplay/talent/ability changes in the 7.41 series: (a) 7.41 increased Razor's Static Link damage drain rate (from 5/10/15/20 to 6/12/18/24) and changed how Aghanim's Shard interacts with some abilities; (b) 7.41c increased Razor's Level 15 talent (Static Link damage steal) from +5 to +6 and increased the Level 20 Storm Surge slow & damage bonus (to +35%); (c) 7.41d included a bugfix/patch addressing Razor's Storm Surge Aghanim's Shard behaviour so that the Shard upgrade applies correctly.

Item changes in the 7.41 series and in 7.41e that affect Razor's common item choices: Dragon Lance / Hurricane Pike ranged attack bonus reduced ( +140 → +130 ); Hurricane Pike cast/push range reduced; Blade Mail recipe/components changed (affects early recipe path and armor component); Butterfly agility/damage numbers were adjusted; Abyssal Blade strength bonus adjusted; Satanic's Unholy Rage cooldown increased in 7.41e (30s → 40s) — these changes can influence Razor's desirability/timing of Hurricane Pike/Dragon Lance, Butterfly, Abyssal Blade, Satanic, and Blade Mail.

High-MMR / pro-weighted itemization signal for Razor in 7.41e (7000+ MMR / pro-weighted data from Dota2ProTracker): Razor's core item progression in the 7.41e sample is Magic Wand → Power Treads → Yasha (Sange & Yasha path) → Black King Bar (BKB). Dota2ProTracker labels those items as 'CORE' (bought in >50% of matches for the reported core build) and reports median buy times: Magic Wand ~4m, Power Treads ~7m, Yasha ~16m, BKB ~25m. The D2PT dataset for Razor (7.41e) is a 7000+ MMR / pro-weighted sample and reports per-item pick/win percentages and median buy times for many situational items as well.

Dota2ProTracker (7.41e, 7000+ MMR / pro-weighted) shows situational item pick shares and median buy times for Razor (examples from the site): Hurricane Pike ~2.2% pick (median buy ~31m), Lotus Orb ~2.4% pick (median buy ~32m), Scythe of Vyse ~2.2% pick (median buy ~43m), Monkey King Bar ~1.9% pick (median buy ~41m), Mask of Madness ~1.1% pick (median buy ~16m). The site also includes neutral-item picks/win rates for Razor in 7.41e (e.g., Possessed Mask, Chipped Vest, Duelist Gloves listed with pick% and win%).

Role-distribution and role-level metrics for Razor in 7.41e: Dotacoach's 7.41e hero page reports Razor is commonly played Offlane in the sample, with Offlane being the most frequent role (~53.3% of Razor games) and showing offlane win ~50.8%; Mid and Carry are the next-most-common roles (Mid ~23.9% pick, win ~51.4%; Carry ~17.4% pick, win ~48.1%). These role breakdowns are available on Dotacoach's Razor page for 7.41e.

Immortal / top-ranked high-MMR item-progression datasets are available to cross-check Dota2ProTracker's 7000+ signals: Spectral provides Immortal-ranked (high MMR) item-progression and timing data for 7.41e which can be used to extract per-item buy timing and popularity for Razor at Immortal/Pro ranks.

Neutral-item behavior and common neutral-item picks on Razor in 7.41e: Dota2ProTracker’s Razor page lists common neutral items and win rates in the 7.41e sample (examples: Possessed Mask and Chipped Vest appear among Tier 1/2 picks with per-item win rates shown). Spectral and D2PT both include neutral-item breakdowns for high-MMR/Immortal matches in 7.41e.

Pro / tournament Razor build data exists and is (a) partially included in pro-weighted aggregates on Dota2ProTracker and (b) available in match-level datasets (OpenDota / DatDota / Spectral) referenced by meta analysts. However, a dedicated extraction of Razor's pro-match item frequencies (counts and win rates from official tournament matches in 7.41e) still needs to be pulled from those match-level sources to produce exact pro-frequency numbers.

Remaining data gaps (confirmed by the sources available): (1) per-item win-rate and pick-rate with confidence intervals broken down by role (Offlane/Mid/Carry) and by MMR bracket (Immortal / 7k+ / overall) require dataset extraction from D2PT, Spectral, Stratz/OpenDota APIs; (2) exact pro/tournament match item frequencies for Razor in 7.41e require pulling match-level tournament datasets (OpenDota/DatDota/Spectral) and aggregating; (3) neutral item pick/win rates by tier for Razor across MMR tiers are available in D2PT / Spectral but need a full export to produce precise ranked lists and statistical intervals.

analysis.summary: All evidence anchors to Dota 2 patch 7.41e (released July 30, 2026). High‑MMR/pro‑weighted data from Dota2ProTracker in 7.41e identifies Razor’s baseline “core” items as Magic Wand, Power Treads, Yasha into Sange & Yasha, and Black King Bar, with typical median purchase times around 4/7/16/25 minutes. Several late‑game or utility items (Hurricane Pike, Lotus Orb, Scythe of Vyse, Monkey King Bar, Mask of Madness) appear as low‑frequency situational choices in this sample. Patch changes in 7.41/7.41e (e.g., Satanic cooldown increase; Hurricane Pike/Dragon Lance range reductions; Butterfly and Abyssal stat adjustments; Blade Mail recipe/armor changes) are relevant context that may influence Razor’s itemization nuances. Role data show Razor is most often played Offlane in 7.41e, but role‑specific item performance metrics were not extracted. Neutral‑item pick/win data exist on D2PT (and Spectral) but were not fully exported, so we cannot rank neutral items or produce item win‑rate/CI tables. Consequently, we can recommend the high‑MMR baseline core set, but we lack sufficient item‑level performance stats (overall/by role/MMR) and pro‑match frequencies to definitively rank the “best” items beyond this baseline.

claims.claim: As of 2026-08-15, the live patch is 7.41e (within the 7.41 series); 7.41 released March 24, 2026, and 7.41e was released/announced July 30, 2026, with subpatches 7.41a–d in between.

Razor received buffs/adjustments in the 7.41 series: base Static Link damage drain increased in 7.41; 7.41c buffed the Level 15 Static Link Damage Steal talent (+5→+6) and the Level 20 Storm Surge slow/damage (+30%→+35%); 7.41d included a Storm Surge Aghanim’s Shard behavior fix.

Item changes in 7.41/7.41e relevant to Razor include: Dragon Lance/Hurricane Pike ranged attack bonus reduced (+140→+130) with Pike cast/push range reduced; Blade Mail recipe/armor adjusted; Butterfly stats adjusted; Abyssal Blade Strength increased; Satanic Unholy Rage cooldown increased (30s→40s in 7.41e); Shiva’s Guard recipe cost decreased (total unchanged).

In 7.41e high‑MMR/pro‑weighted data (Dota2ProTracker), Razor’s commonly used core progression is Magic Wand → Power Treads → Yasha (into Sange & Yasha) → Black King Bar, which D2PT labels as ‘CORE’ (bought in >50% of matches for the core build).

Dota2ProTracker reports median buy times for Razor’s core items around: Magic Wand ~4 minutes, Power Treads ~7 minutes, Yasha ~16 minutes, Black King Bar ~25 minutes in 7.41e high‑MMR/pro‑weighted matches.

Several situational items show low pick shares for Razor in 7.41e high‑MMR/pro‑weighted data: Hurricane Pike (~2.2% pick, median ~31m), Lotus Orb (~2.4%, ~32m), Scythe of Vyse (~2.2%, ~43m), Monkey King Bar (~1.9%, ~41m), Mask of Madness (~1.1%, ~16m).
Dota2ProTracker lists neutral‑item picks and per‑item win rates for Razor in 7.41e (e.g., Possessed Mask, Chipped Vest, Duelist Gloves among early tiers).
Razor is most commonly played Offlane in 7.41e, with Dotacoach reporting Offlane ~53.3% of Razor games and ~50.8% win; Mid ~23.9% pick with ~51.4% win; Carry ~17.4% pick with ~48.1% win.
Spectral provides Immortal‑rank item‑progression/timing datasets for 7.41e that can cross‑check high‑MMR Razor item timings and popularity.
Exact pro/tournament‑match Razor item frequencies and item‑level win rates were not extracted here and would require pulling match‑level datasets (e.g., OpenDota/DatDota/Spectral) for 7.41e.

Per‑item win rates (with confidence intervals), pick rates, and median buy times by role (Offlane/Mid/Carry) and MMR for Razor in 7.41e are available in principle from D2PT/Spectral/STRATZ but were not exported here.

contradictions: Community guides list a wide set of situational Razor items (e.g., Manta, Shiva’s, Butterfly, Satanic) as common options, while high‑MMR/pro‑weighted data in 7.41e show some of these are low‑frequency on Razor (e.g., Hurricane Pike, MKB, Mask of Madness). This is likely a difference in context/MMR emphasis rather than a direct data conflict. (SRC11 vs SRC8)

final_answer.answer:
Summary (patch window):
- Live patch used for these recommendations is the 7.41 series, currently on 7.41e (7.41 initial release March 24, 2026; 7.41e released July 30, 2026). Use guidance below as valid for 7.41e. (SRC1, SRC3, SRC6)

Core build (high‑MMR / pro‑weighted signal in 7.41e):
- Core progression observed in 7.41e (7000+ MMR / pro‑weighted sample): Magic Wand → Power Treads → Yasha (into Sange & Yasha) → Black King Bar (BKB). Dota2ProTracker labels these as “core” (>50% for the core build) and reports median buy times roughly: Magic Wand ~4m, Power Treads ~7m, Yasha ~16m, BKB ~25m. This is the safest baseline build in the current patch. (SRC8)

Situational / low‑frequency but sometimes useful items (7.41e signals):
- Hurricane Pike / Dragon Lance: now give reduced ranged bonus and Pike push/cast range is smaller — Pike is low frequency on Razor in 7.41e (~2.2% pick in the D2PT sample) and is a late, situational pickup. (SRC2, SRC1, SRC8)
- Lotus Orb, Scythe of Vyse, Monkey King Bar, Mask of Madness: appear in the high‑MMR/pro sample at low pick rates and late median buy times — useful situationally but not core in this sample. (SRC8)
- Sange & Yasha vs Manta: the D2PT core path shows Yasha into Sange & Yasha in the sampled builds; community guides also list Manta and other Yasha upgrades as common situational options. Exact win‑rate comparisons by path were not extracted here. (SRC8, SRC11)
- Maelstrom/Mjollnir, Shiva’s, Butterfly, Satanic, Abyssal, Blade Mail, Nullifier: these items are commonly mentioned in community/pro guides and are viable in various matchups; 7.41/7.41e changed several of their stats/recipes (see notes below) which affect timing/efficiency. (SRC11, SRC1, SRC5)

Patch item changes that affect Razor item choices in 7.41 → 7.41e:
- Dragon Lance / Hurricane Pike: ranged attack bonus reduced (+140 → +130) and Pike push/cast range reduced — slightly weakens the value of Pike/Lance for range/tether spacing. (SRC2, SRC1)
- Blade Mail: recipe/components changed (affects early path and armor component). (SRC1, SRC2)
- Butterfly: agility/damage numbers adjusted. (SRC5)
- Abyssal Blade: strength bonus adjusted. (SRC5)
- Satanic: Unholy Rage cooldown increased in 7.41e (30s → 40s) — makes Satanic a less flexible lifesteal choice for Razor (longer downtime). (SRC5)
- Shiva’s Guard: recipe cost changed (total unchanged). (SRC5)
- Aghanim’s Shard / Storm Surge interactions: there were fixes/adjustments to how Razor’s Storm Surge/Aghanim’s Shard interacts (7.41d/7.41e). (SRC7, SRC4)

Role context:
- Razor is most frequently played Offlane in the 7.41e samples (Offlane ~53.3% of games), with Mid and Carry being secondary roles. Item priorities can shift by role; the D2PT core above reflects high‑MMR/pro‑weighted matches where Offlane/Mid roles are common. (SRC9, SRC8)

Practical guidance for item selection in 7.41e:
- If you want a safe, meta‑aligned build: follow Magic Wand → Power Treads → Yasha → Sange & Yasha → BKB. Use the median buy times above as timing goals (Wand ~4m, Treads ~7m, Yasha ~16m, BKB ~25m). (SRC8)
- Buy BKB vs heavy control/disable lineups — it is part of the documented core. (SRC8)
- Consider defensive/utility items (Lotus, Hurricane Pike) situationally, but note they are low frequency on Razor in the high‑MMR sample; their value depends on enemy draft (e.g., heavy single‑target lockdown, save needs, or kiting threats). (SRC8, SRC2)
- Re‑evaluate Satanic as a pickup: the 7.41e cooldown increase makes it less attractive as a frequent lifesteal insurance item — weigh its later‑game value against longer downtime. (SRC5)
- Neutral items: common neutral picks such as Possessed Mask or Chipped Vest appear in 7.41e high‑MMR data for Razor; neutral choices can be impactful but full ranked neutral‑item win rates by tier were not exported here. (SRC8, SRC10)

Limitations / unresolved gaps (important):
- The research here does NOT include per‑item win rates with confidence intervals broken down by role (Offlane/Mid/Carry) or by MMR bracket, nor exact pro/tournament build frequencies in 7.41e. That means we cannot produce a statistically ranked list of the single “best” items beyond the high‑MMR core signal. (SRC8, SRC10, SRC12)
- Many community/pro guides list a wider set of viable Razor items (Manta, Shiva’s, Maelstrom, Butterfly, Abyssal, Satanic, Nullifier, etc.). The high‑MMR/pro‑weighted sample in 7.41e shows several of those as low‑frequency situational picks — this likely reflects matchup/role context and high‑MMR preference differences rather than outright ineffectiveness. (SRC11 vs SRC8)

If you want a definitive ranked list (win rates with CIs, role‑split pick/win, pro/tournament frequency), I can next: (1) export Razor item pick/win/median time by role and MMR from Dota2ProTracker and Spectral, and (2) pull pro match item frequencies from OpenDota/Spectral — tell me if you want me to run those extra extractions.
